# Humidity control (`humidity-control`)

Target humidity with − / +, the current reading, a mode and whether it is running, for humidifiers and dehumidifiers.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createHumidityControl` (types in `dist/web/home/climate-energy/humidityControl.d.ts`): `.mh-humidity-control`: an optional `__power` switch row, the target big between − / + buttons (`__target`group with `__adjust`, `__step` buttons and an `__value` output of `__number` and `__unit`), a `__gauge` (0–100%`__track` with the `__comfort` band, the `__marker--target` tick and the `__marker--current` dot; hidden fromscreen readers, the words say the same), the `__status` line (`__current` reading and the `__action` hint`--humidifying | --drying | --idle | --off`) and the `__mode` control. Taps change the number at once and`onTarget` fires once they settle. Modifier `--compact`; states `.is-off`, `.is-disabled`.

```ts
export function createHumidityControl(options: HumidityControlOptions): HumidityControlHandle;

export interface HumidityControlOptions {
  /** Accessible name of the whole control (default "Humidity"). */
  label?: string;
  /** The measured relative humidity, in percent. */
  current?: number | null;
  /** The target, in percent. */
  target?: number | null;
  /** Default 30. */
  min?: number;
  /** Default 80. */
  max?: number;
  /** One tap of − / + (default 1); also sets the decimals shown. */
  step?: number;
  /** A boolean shows the power switch. */
  on?: boolean | null;
  mode?: string;
  /** Up to four become a segmented control, more a select. */
  modes?: readonly HumidityMode[];
  action?: HumidityAction | null;
  /** The band drawn as comfortable on the gauge (default 40–60%); `null` hides it. */
  comfort?: HumidityComfort | null;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Smaller type and controls, for small cards. */
  compact?: boolean;
  labels?: Partial<HumidityControlLabels>;
  /** Idle time after the last tap before `onTarget` fires, in ms (default 700). */
  delay?: number;
  /** The new target, once the taps settle. */
  onTarget?: (value: number) => void;
  onMode?: (value: string) => void;
  onToggle?: (on: boolean) => void;
}

export interface HumidityControlHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  /** Applies changed options; omitted ones keep their value. A target still being tapped stays on screen. */
  update(changes: Partial<HumidityControlOptions>): void;
  /** Sends a target that is still waiting for the taps to settle. */
  destroy(): void;
}

/** Every visible and spoken word, for translation. */
export interface HumidityControlLabels {
  power: string;
  target: string;
  lower: string;
  raise: string;
  /** Before the current reading ("Now 48%"). */
  now: string;
  mode: string;
  humidifying: string;
  drying: string;
  idle: string;
  off: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createHumidityControl } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const humidifier = createHumidityControl({
  label: 'Nursery humidity',
  current: 36,
  target: 45,
  on: true,
  action: 'humidifying',
  mode: 'normal',
  modes: [
    { value: 'normal', label: 'Normal' },
    { value: 'sleep', label: 'Sleep' },
  ],
  // Called once the taps settle, so one change is sent rather than one per tap.
  onTarget: (target) => humidifier.update({ target }),
  onMode: (mode) => humidifier.update({ mode }),
  onToggle: (on) => humidifier.update({ on, action: on ? 'humidifying' : 'off' }),
});

document.body.append(humidifier.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { HumidityControl } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const MODES = [
  { value: 'normal', label: 'Normal' },
  { value: 'sleep', label: 'Sleep' },
];

export function HumidityControlExample() {
  const [on, setOn] = useState(true);
  const [target, setTarget] = useState(45);
  const [mode, setMode] = useState('normal');
  return (
    <HumidityControl
      label="Nursery humidity"
      current={36}
      target={target}
      on={on}
      action={on ? 'humidifying' : 'off'}
      mode={mode}
      modes={MODES}
      // Called once the taps settle, so one change is sent rather than one per tap.
      onTarget={setTarget}
      onMode={setMode}
      onToggle={setOn}
    />
  );
}
```
